events.title: Digital Healthcare World Congress 2026
events.location: Kensington Conference and Event Centre, London
events.summary: Annual London conference and expo covering AI, digital health, medtech, IoT, pharma, genomics and healthcare IT, with speakers from major tech and health organisations.
events.means: Primarily an international tech and vendor crowd rather than an NHS buyer crowd. Worth considering for networking with fellow suppliers and innovators, but less useful for direct NHS pipeline development.

events.title: GIANT Health Event 2026
events.summary: A health innovation festival of several shows-within-a-show, with 3,000-plus participants and 120-plus speakers across startups, investors and NHS innovators.
events.means: Built for startups and innovators, with pitch and showcase formats. Suits early-stage founders wanting exposure and investor contacts. NHS-buyer density is lower than HETT or ConfedExpo.

events.title: DigiFest Scotland 2026
events.summary: The anchor conference for Scotland's digital health and social care ecosystem, themed around turning ideas into action.
events.means: The right event if Scotland is a target market, gathering the Scottish digital health and care community and its decision-makers. Less relevant if you focus only on NHS England.

events.title: Genesis Conference 2026
events.summary: The 26th annual London life science and healthcare networking conference organised by One Nucleus, attracting around 400 attendees for plenary talks, panels from key opinion leaders, one-to-one partnering sessions and an exhibition showcasing life science sector providers.
events.means: A well-established networking and partnering event for the Cambridge and London life sciences cluster, weighted towards biotech and medtech founders, academics and investors rather than NHS operational buyers. Worth attending for startup founders seeking co-development partners or investor introductions, but not primarily an NHS commercial or digital health event.

events.title: Health, social care and life sciences policy review: 2026 year in review
events.summary: The end-of-year edition of techUK's quarterly digital health policy briefing, recapping developments across NHS England, DHSC, the MHRA and NICE.
events.means: A good catch-up if you missed the quarterly editions. Useful for planning next year's NHS commercial activity around the policy direction.

events.title: HFMA Procurement Forum 2027
events.location: In-person, UK (venue TBC at time of search)
events.cost: HFMA member rates apply; check site
events.summary: A one-day forum bringing together NHS finance and procurement colleagues to explore joint working, best practice and the priorities for NHS commercial teams in 2027.
events.means: Squarely aimed at NHS finance and procurement directors. Useful for founders if understanding buyer-side commercial pressures and frameworks is on the agenda, but expect few direct sales conversations.

events.title: Festival of Genomics and Biodata London 2027
events.cost: Free for many roles; commercial paid
events.summary: A large free-to-attend festival covering genomics, biodata and their application across research and the NHS, with a big exhibition.
events.means: Most relevant if your product touches genomics, data or precision medicine, where it draws a serious research and NHS crowd. Free passes make it easy to scout.

events.title: AI Britain Summit 2027
events.summary: A one-day summit examining how AI is reshaping UK public services, procurement and government, with NHS clinical documentation, procurement frameworks and AI adoption in public services featuring prominently on the agenda.
events.means: Audience spans central government, NHS, local authorities and UK AI firms rather than being a pure digital-health trade show. Founders selling AI into the NHS will find useful policy context and procurement-focused sessions, but it is a policy and government day more than a commercial sales environment.

events.title: European Healthcare Real Assets Conference 2027
events.summary: Second edition of a high-level forum for investors and industry leaders focused on healthcare real assets, infrastructure, and capital allocation across the European healthcare sector.
events.means: This is a pure investor and institutional capital event, not a buyer or NHS procurement crowd. Useful if you are actively raising a round or seeking strategic real-assets partners, but limited direct NHS commercial value.

events.title: HSJ Digital Transformation Summit 2027
events.summary: A senior leadership summit bringing digital, clinical and operational leaders together on delivery of the NHS 10-Year Digital Plan.
events.means: Strong for vendors who want time with senior NHS digital decision-makers. Invitation and sponsor-led, so plan ahead if you want a presence.

events.title: Digital Health and Care Scotland 2027
events.summary: Scotland's long-running annual digital health and care conference, gathering political voices, health leaders and public and third sector representatives.
events.means: A focused way to reach Scottish health and care leadership and policy figures in one day. Strong if Scotland is on your roadmap.

events.title: HETT Leaders Summit 2027
events.cost: Paid (supplier); NHS and public sector free or subsidised
events.summary: A one-day peer-learning and facilitated networking summit for senior NHS and public sector digital leaders, sitting alongside the broader HETT event ecosystem. Focused on shared challenges, leadership insight, and meaningful supplier-buyer connection.
events.means: The room is senior NHS digital leaders, CCIOs, and CIOs, making it one of the more useful single-day buyer-access events in the calendar. For founders, it is most valuable if you already have a product in market and want face time with decision-makers rather than a general awareness play.

events.title: IGPP AI in Healthcare Conference 2027 (Manchester)
events.organiser: Institute of Government and Public Policy (IGPP)
events.cost: From £249 + VAT; free for NHS and public sector
events.summary: A single-day conference bringing together NHS leaders, clinicians, policymakers, regulators, and tech innovators to examine how AI can be embedded safely across health and care, from pilots to proven pathways.
events.means: The crowd skews toward NHS operational and policy people rather than buyers with budget. Good for founders who need to understand adoption blockers and regulatory direction. Not a primary sales event, but useful for thought leadership and direct NHS insight.

events.title: EstatesVision 2027: The Health Estates Conference
events.cost: Check site; Convenzis events typically subsidised or free for NHS
events.summary: A targeted platform for suppliers and technology providers supporting NHS estate transformation, digital infrastructure, and the development of Neighbourhood Health Centres. Covers AI-enabled estate operations, interoperability, and capital programme management.
events.means: The buyer crowd here is NHS estates and facilities managers, not clinical or IT procurement leads. Relevant only if your product touches hospital infrastructure, building management, or digital-physical integration. Skip it if you sell clinical software or diagnostics.

events.title: Path360 2027: NHS Pathology Strategy Conference North
events.summary: A Convenzis conference on NHS pathology strategy and diagnostics for the North of England.
events.means: Niche, for diagnostics and pathology technology vendors. Highly targeted if that is your sector, otherwise skip.

events.title: CareAnywhere 2027: The NHS Virtual Care Strategy Conference
events.cost: Free for NHS; commercial paid (up to ~£500)
events.summary: A single-day NHS-focused conference on virtual hospitals, hospital-at-home services, remote clinical pathways and digitally enabled models of care. NHS case studies and deep-dive sessions from trusts implementing virtual ward and early-supported-discharge programmes.
events.means: The room is NHS operational and clinical leaders building virtual care models, making it a strong pipeline event for suppliers of remote monitoring, virtual ward platforms and digital pathway tools. Policy and investor content is limited; this is a buyer-heavy day.

events.title: CyberSecure 2027: The NHS Cyber Security Conference
events.location: etc.venues Prospero House, 241 Borough High St, London
events.summary: A one-day Convenzis summit addressing NHS cyber security challenges including ransomware, identity and access management, AI threat detection, and digital resilience. Designed for NHS senior managers and technology suppliers operating in the NHS security space.
events.means: The room is predominantly NHS IT, cyber and operations managers; it is a buyer-heavy crowd for a very specific niche. Worth it if your product touches NHS cyber resilience, data protection or secure digital infrastructure; less useful for general digital health or AI founders.

events.title: Advanced Therapies Congress 2027
events.summary: Europe's largest commercial cell and gene therapy conference and exhibition, bringing together pharma, biotech and startup executives across the full ATMP value chain, with 300 speakers and 75 startups over two days.
events.means: This is a pharma and biotech industry event, not an NHS buyer crowd. Worth it for founders building in cell and gene therapy or regenerative medicine seeking partners, investors or payers; less relevant for broader digital health or NHS-facing SaaS plays.

events.title: IGPP AI in Healthcare Conference 2027 (London)
events.organiser: Institute of Government and Public Policy (IGPP)
events.cost: From £249 + VAT; free for NHS and public sector
events.summary: A London edition of IGPP's AI in Healthcare series, exploring how AI moves from NHS pilots to scaled, safe deployment, with a focus on procurement strategies, governance, and clinical validation.
events.means: Similar to the Manchester edition: the audience is NHS leaders and policymakers, not procurement budget holders. Valuable for founders wanting credibility and policy intelligence in a smaller, focused room, especially if you cannot make both dates.

events.title: Medical Technology UK 2027
events.cost: Free to attend (exhibition and learning programme)
events.summary: A specialist two-day exhibition for medical device design, development and manufacturing, bringing together medtech engineers, supply chain professionals, procurement leads and senior OEM executives. The event runs alongside a learning programme covering device regulation, NHS adoption and manufacturing innovation.
events.means: This is a supply chain and manufacturing crowd, not an NHS digital buyer event. It is worth attending if your product involves hardware, device manufacturing or regulated medtech components and you want to reach procurement and supply chain decision-makers in the device sector rather than NHS CIOs or digital transformation leads.

events.title: Digital Health Rewired 2027
events.cost: Free for NHS and public sector; commercial from £769 + VAT
events.summary: The UK's leading digital health conference and expo, with ten-plus stages of national digital leaders, NHS CIOs, CCIOs, CNIOs, clinicians and a startup pitchfest.
events.means: Alongside ConfedExpo and HETT this is essential for digital health founders, with a real concentration of NHS digital decision-makers and a dedicated startup zone. Book early, it sells out.

events.title: Holyrood Public Sector Data and AI Summit 2027
events.summary: A Scottish public-sector summit covering data strategy, AI adoption and digital transformation across devolved government, NHS Scotland and public services, aimed at senior public-sector leaders and their technology partners.
events.means: Primarily a Scottish public-sector policy and leadership day. Worth attending if you are targeting NHS Scotland or Scottish Government contracts, but the crowd is predominantly NHS and public-sector delegates rather than a strong commercial buyer or investor audience.

events.title: HFMA Delivering Value with Digital Technologies 2027
events.cost: Free for HFMA partners; commercial ticket available on request
events.summary: A webinar series for NHS finance and digital leaders exploring how technology delivers value-based healthcare aligned with NHS financial priorities.
events.means: This is an NHS-internal audience: finance directors, digital leaders and HFMA partner organisations. Commercial vendors can attend but it is primarily a policy and best-practice forum, not a buyer-facing sales opportunity.

events.title: BioTrinity 2027
events.summary: Now in its 21st year, BioTrinity is the UK's leading life sciences partnering and investment conference, connecting R&D companies and startups with investors, pharmaceutical leaders, and industry partners through one-to-one meetings, showcase presentations, and networking.
events.means: Primarily an investor and pharma BD crowd. Healthtech and medtech founders at pre-Series A to Series A stage will find genuine investor access. Less relevant if your product is already deployed in the NHS and you are chasing procurement rather than fundraising.

events.title: Anglonordic Europe Life Science Conference 2027
events.summary: A curated partnering conference bringing together innovative biotech, health technology, and drug discovery companies with active investors and pharma leaders in a highly structured one-to-one meeting format, now in its 23rd year.
events.means: A focused investor-to-company partnering event with 94 investment firms registered. Ideal for founders actively fundraising. Very limited NHS buyer or procurement presence, so of little value for commercial sales teams.

events.title: Revive UK 2027
events.summary: A longevity and health technology exhibition and conference covering preventive health, diagnostics, AI, regenerative medicine, and digital healthcare, drawing innovators, clinicians, investors, and policymakers.
events.means: A broad consumer-facing and industry event rather than a focused NHS procurement gathering. Useful for founders building consumer healthtech or longevity products seeking investor visibility, but NHS buyer presence is unproven for this newer event.

events.title: Health + AI Tech Show 2027
events.summary: A UK national platform focused on applied AI technology in healthcare, aiming to bridge the gap between AI pilots and real-world NHS deployment, bringing together NHS leaders, pharma, biotech and AI startups.
events.means: Positioned as clinically led and procurement ready, targeting the deployment gap rather than research hype. Relevant for AI health founders seeking NHS access routes, though as a relatively new show the audience size and buyer quality is still unproven.

events.title: P4H Scotland 2027
events.cost: Free for public sector buyers; commercial rates for suppliers (TBC)
events.summary: Scotland's dedicated healthcare procurement event connecting buyers and suppliers across Scotland's healthcare procurement community, worth more than 3.6 billion pounds annually, with skills development, networking and product showcase opportunities.
events.means: The audience is NHS Scotland procurement buyers and supply chain professionals. Essential if you are selling into Scottish health boards and want face time with the people who run frameworks and tenders; less value if your market is England-only.

events.title: Digi-Tech Pharma & AI 2027 Conference
events.summary: A two-day RSC conference uniting pharma and technology leaders to explore AI, machine learning, digital health ecosystems, clinical trials data science, and real-world evidence in drug development.
events.means: Pharma R&D and health data science focused, not an NHS procurement crowd. Worth it for founders selling AI or data tools into life sciences and pharma pipelines rather than directly into NHS trusts.

events.title: UK Biotech Day 2027
events.summary: An international premier event for life science leaders, innovators, investors, and service providers, showcasing UK life sciences innovation and catalysing partnerships between national and global players.
events.means: An outward-facing showcase and partnering event aimed at connecting UK founders with international investors and pharma. NHS commercial teams will find limited direct buyer access here; it is better suited to founders raising capital or seeking global partnerships.

events.title: Investors in Healthcare Private Capital Conference 2027
events.organiser: European Healthcare Investor Association (EHIA) and Rothschild and Co
events.summary: Third edition of a focused private capital conference bringing together corporate leaders and investors to facilitate transactions and promote investment across European healthcare, life sciences, and pharma sectors.
events.means: A deal-focused investor and corporate M&A event. Highly relevant for founders at growth or exit stage seeking PE or strategic acquirers. Not useful for early-stage commercial teams targeting NHS procurement.

events.title: NHS ConfedExpo 2027
events.cost: Free for NHS Confederation members, NHS staff, and wider public sector; paid for commercial attendees (up to approx. £995)
events.summary: The UK's largest health and care conference, delivered by NHS Confederation and NHS England, bringing together over 5,000 leaders, clinicians, and partners. Covers NHS strategy, digital transformation, and system-wide innovation.
events.means: This is the single biggest gathering of NHS senior leaders in the UK calendar. The buyer density is very high. For founders and commercial teams, it is essential for visibility, relationship building with ICS and trust leads, and understanding which national priorities are getting real traction.

events.title: Procurex England 2027
events.location: England (venue TBC; 2026 edition held in Liverpool)
events.summary: England's leading public procurement event, bringing together public sector buyers, procurement leaders and suppliers for a full day of insight, networking and market engagement. NHS organisations are a major buyer segment.
events.means: The audience is public sector procurement professionals across all sectors, not exclusively NHS digital buyers. Useful for founders at an early commercial stage wanting to understand public procurement pathways and meet NHS supply chain contacts, but expect a broad mix rather than a digital health crowd.

events.title: Digital Health Summer Schools 2027
events.summary: Two-day education and networking event dedicated to NHS CCIOs, CIOs, CNIOs and current and aspiring digital health leaders, run by the team behind Digital Health Rewired.
events.means: This is an NHS leadership development event, not a sales floor. Founders will find limited commercial opportunity here; it is better suited to understanding what NHS digital leaders are actually thinking and building relationships at a senior level.

events.title: AIiH 2027: International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare
events.summary: The fourth edition of this academic-practitioner conference brings together researchers, clinicians and innovators to present and discuss AI methods and their application across NHS and global healthcare settings.
events.means: Primarily a research and academic crowd, though NHS practitioners and some commercial teams attend. Best for founders who want to build academic credibility, find clinical validation partners or recruit, rather than for direct sales pipeline.

events.title: HealthX Innovation and Technology Show 2027
events.summary: A two-day London summit and expo where healthcare, pharma, MedTech, diagnostics and AI leaders convene to discuss digital transformation, with listed participants from NHS, Pfizer, AstraZeneca, Microsoft and Google Health.
events.means: The speaker list features large pharma and tech giants more than NHS buyers, giving this more of an industry and strategy flavour than a direct procurement opportunity. Worth evaluating for partnership conversations but founders should verify the NHS buyer presence before committing budget.

events.title: Med-Tech Expo 2027
events.summary: The UK's leading medical device manufacturing and supply chain trade show, connecting designers, engineers, manufacturers, and buyers from organisations including NHS, Stryker, Johnson and Johnson, and Medtronic. Features a conference programme alongside the exhibition floor.
events.means: The crowd is predominantly medical device engineers, supply chain buyers, and manufacturers rather than NHS digital decision-makers. Best suited to founders selling physical medtech or device software; less relevant if your product is purely a digital or data platform.

events.title: Life Sciences Week 2027
events.cost: Free to register; individual events may be ticketed
events.summary: A week-long programme of conferences, roundtables, showcases, and networking events bringing together life sciences professionals, researchers, and businesses to explore innovation, investment, AI in biotech, and medtech across the UK.
events.means: A broad community and ecosystem event rather than a focused NHS sales opportunity. Good for visibility, networking, and meeting investors or partners, but founders should check the specific sub-events within the week to identify which sessions match their goals.

events.title: World Health AI London 2027
events.summary: A focused one-day annual summit for NHS C-suite, clinical leaders and health AI researchers exploring how machine intelligence and large language models reach clinical practice safely and at scale.
events.means: A curated, senior-only room of NHS AI decision-makers and clinical leaders. Good for founders who want peer-level conversations with the people who set and fund AI strategy, not a mass-market expo.

events.title: HETT Show 2027
events.cost: Free for NHS and public sector; commercial paid
events.summary: The UK's leading annual healthtech conference and exhibition, bringing together thousands of NHS digital leaders, clinicians, IT professionals and technology suppliers to explore digital transformation, AI, cybersecurity and innovation across health and care.
events.means: Strong buyer crowd with NHS trust CIOs, CDIOs and procurement leads attending in large numbers, making it one of the best two events of the year for commercial pipeline alongside Rewired. Worth the investment for any team selling software, data or AI solutions into NHS.

events.title: HDR UK Conference 2027
events.summary: The UK's flagship annual health data science conference, covering AI in healthcare, data-driven NHS solutions, data infrastructure, information governance, and real-world evidence. Attracts researchers, data scientists, NHS analysts, industry and patient advocates.
events.means: Primarily an academic and research crowd, with strong NHS data and informatics representation. Valuable for founders building on NHS data pipelines, real-world evidence platforms, or health AI with a clinical research angle; less suited to pure commercial sales.

events.title: HCSA Annual Conference 2027
events.summary: The flagship annual event for NHS procurement and supply chain professionals, drawing over 800 delegates for peer networking, expert presentations and direct engagement with NHS commercial decision-makers.
events.means: The best single event in the UK for reaching NHS procurement leads in one room. If your product needs to navigate NHS commercial frameworks or supply chain, this is where the buyers and decision-makers actually are.
